- Improve first-contact messaging when a handheld needs to discover the sender before receiving an attachment.
- Answer path requests more reliably over LoRa and other interfaces, so peers can find a handheld without requiring a manual announce.
- Browse peers in one continuous list, with steadier selection and live updates on every handheld.
- Keep message delivery labels stable during status refreshes and show a separate retry action only after persistent refresh failures.

All handheld firmware is beta. Cardputer requires a Cap LoRa-1262 with an antenna for LoRa.

Factory ZIP installs erase settings, identity, and internal message history. Back up anything you want to keep before installing.
